title: Two-islands
intro: Black keys live in little islands. Find two black keys side by side, and play them both!
again: Now find another two-island. Higher or lower!
hint: Look for two black keys together. Fingers two and three fit on them.

title: Three-islands
intro: Some islands have three black keys. Find one, and play all three!
hint: Three black keys together. Fingers two, three and four fit on them.

title: Home C
intro: C lives just left of a two-island. Find a C!
hint: Find a two-island. C is the white key right next to it, on the left.

title: Finger names
intro: Thumb is one, pinky is five. Listen to the cloud, then play the flower it sang.
hint: Watch the glowing flower. Its number is your finger.

title: Raindrops
intro: Let your arm drop the note like a raindrop, then float up. Listen first, then it's your turn.
hint: Listen again. Drop, then float up on the quiet beat.

title: Five drops
intro: Now every flower wants rain. One drop each, then float up.
hint: One drop, one quiet beat. Listen to where the cloud is.

title: Steps
intro: Two drops next door to each other, like little steps. Then float up.
hint: Next-door flowers. Step, step, then rest.

title: Little tunes
intro: The cloud sings little tunes now. Listen, then rain them back.
hint: Listen to the whole tune first. Up or down?
pool: C4 D4 E4 - E4 D4 C4 -

title: By ear
intro: The cloud hides the flowers now. Can you find them just by listening?
hint: Tap the eye to see the flowers again. That's fine!
